title: NXT Capital Closes Senior Credit Facility in Support of Incline Equity Partners’ Acquisition of The Conrad Company
summary: Chicago, IL – NXT Capital announced today that it closed a senior credit facility in support of Incline Equity Partners’ acquisition of The Conrad Comp
body_markdown:
**Chicago, IL** – NXT Capital announced today that it closed a senior credit facility in support of Incline Equity Partners’ acquisition of The Conrad Company.


NXT Capital acted as Sole Lead Arranger, Sole Bookrunner, and Administrative Agent on this transaction.


“It’s a pleasure to team up with NXT Capital on another successful transaction,” said Michael Antonelli, Managing Director, Incline Equity Partners. “NXT delivered competitive terms and a seamless financing process. We look forward to our ongoing partnership to support The Conrad Company’s continued growth.”


[The Conrad Company](https://tccholdings.com/) (“TCC”) is a value-added distributor and service provider of fluid power, motion control automation and related industrial products.


Headquartered in York, PA, TCC’s pneumatic, hydraulic, automation, lubrication and compressed air offerings support a diverse customer base including manufacturing plants, food and beverage facilities and industrial customers. As a solutions provider to both OEMs and end users, the Company’s comprehensive portfolio of products are supported by ongoing technical service and repair capabilities.


[Incline Equity Partners](https://inclineequity.com/) is a leading private equity firm dedicated to investing across the middle market in services, value-added distribution, software & technology and specialized light manufacturing companies. Incline is generally seeking growing companies with enterprise values of $25 – $750 million. Incline’s typical investment types are ownership transitions for privately held businesses, buyouts and corporate divestitures within the U.S. and Canada.


[NXT Capital](https://www.nxtcapital.com/) provides structured financing solutions through its Direct Lending group and targets U.S.-based borrowers with EBITDA between $5 million and $50 million. Since NXT Capital’s inception in 2010, their Direct Lending team has closed over $27 billion in loan commitments in more than 540 platform transactions. NXT Capital is based in Chicago with offices in Dallas and New York and is the direct lending focused wholly-owned subsidiary of ORIX Corporation USA.
